The possible difference triples \((x-y,\ y-z,\ z-x)\) are permutations of \((1,-1,0)\).

Checking all six:

- \((1,0,-1)\):  
  \(x-y=1,\ y-z=0 \Rightarrow (x,y,z)=(203,202,202)\), giving \(x+2y+3z=1213\).

- \((-1,1,0)\):  
  \((x,y,z)=(202,203,202)\), giving \(1214\).

- \((0,-1,1)\):  
  \((x,y,z)=(202,202,203)\), giving \(1215\).

The other three permutations do not give integer solutions with sum \(607\).

Thus the minimum is \(1213\).

\[
\boxed{1213}
\]
